testimonials.title: Cosa dicono gli utenti
testimonials.subtitle: Feedback da utenti reali e sicuramente non inventati

quote_1.text: Prima passavo ore a configurare manualmente le patch. Ora clicco solo su «Patch» e vado a prepararmi un caffè. Quando torno, è tutto fatto. Rivoluzionario!
quote_1.author: Lisa Smith

quote_2.text: Tutti gli altri patcher sembrano un’operazione al cervello a occhi bendati. Con Morphe bastano pochi clic e la mia app patchata è più potente che mai.
quote_2.author: Alex Chen

quote_3.text: È come Vanced, ma migliore e senza quell’atmosfera strana da festa aziendale.
quote_3.author: Sarah Johnson

quote_4.text: La mia nonna di 87 anni mi ha chiesto perché YouTube sembra diverso. Le ho mostrato Morphe e ora patcha app per tutta la sua comunità di pensionati.
quote_4.author: David Kin

quote_5.text: Ho provato altri patcher e il mio telefono ha preso fuoco. Con Morphe, il telefono è semplicemente perfettamente modificato. 10/10 — non esploderebbe più spontaneamente.
quote_5.author: Ryan Martinez

quote_6.text: Il mio gatto ha fatto cadere il telefono dal tavolo mentre Morphe stava patchando. Il telefono ha resistito e il patch è stato completato con successo. Gatto approvato.
quote_6.author: Emma Jones

quote_7.text: Ho mostrato Morphe a mio padre, che non capisce nulla di tecnologia. Ora patcha le app meglio di me. Sto mettendo in discussione tutta la mia carriera in IT.
quote_7.author: Tom Anderson

quote_8.text: La mia ex ragazza è tornata con me dopo che ho iniziato a usare Morphe. Coincidenza? Non credo!
quote_8.author: Mike Thompson

quote_9.text: Morphe è l’unica cosa che mi salva dagli annunci di dentifricio di 60 secondi impossibili da saltare.
quote_9.author: Casey Morgan

quote_10.text: Pensavo che Morphe fosse un oscuro dio greco. In realtà è meglio.
quote_10.author: Oliver Grant

quote_11.text: Prima di scoprire Morphe pensavo che APK fosse una nuova band K-pop. Ora so meglio.
quote_11.author: Jeff Cooper

quote_12.text: Quando ho visto che Morphe è gratuito, ho reagito come se mi offrissero campioni gratuiti di cibo. Non penso, agisco.
quote_12.author: Tyler James

quote_13.text: Morphe ha sistemato il mio WiFi, pagato le tasse e risolto la fame nel mondo. Ok, no, ma ha patchato YouTube perfettamente.
quote_13.author: Sarah Williams

quote_14.text: Ho mostrato Morphe al mio cane e ora usa la tecnologia meglio di me.
quote_14.author: Kevin Park

quote_15.text: Morphe ha patchato le mie app così bene che ora mi chiedo se può anche patchare le mie scelte di vita.
quote_15.author: Doug Miller

quote_16.text: Ho cliccato il pulsante sbagliato e sono diventato miliardario per caso. Non so come sia successo, ma Morphe c’era di mezzo.
quote_16.author: Lucky Luke

quote_17.text: Grazie al blocco pubblicità di Morphe, finalmente ho avuto la chiarezza mentale per terminare la mia ricerca e cambiare il corso della storia umana. Morphe merita il Nobel più di me.
quote_17.author: Dr. Sheldon Lee

quote_18.text: Ho mostrato Morphe ai miei amici e ora pensano che io sia una specie di mago tecnologico underground. Non li correggo.
quote_18.author: Owen Price

quote_19.text: Morphe ha bloccato così tante pubblicità che il mio telefono sembra più leggero. Penso abbia perso peso emotivo.
quote_19.author: Sienna Brooks

app-features.title: Funzionalità dell'App
app-features.subtitle: Patch potenti per le tue app preferite
app-features.youtube-desc: Un'esperienza YouTube personalizzata con blocco degli annunci, supporto SponsorBlock, controlli del lettore migliorati e avanzate miglioramenti della privacy
app-features.yt-ad-blocking-desc: Rimuove tutti gli annunci dal feed della home e dal lettore video per una visione senza interruzioni.
app-features.sponsorblock-desc: Salta automaticamente i segmenti sponsorizzati e altre parti non essenziali dei video.
app-features.return-dislikes-desc: Mostra i conteggi dei dislike alimentati dalla community per prendere decisioni di visualizzazione migliori.
app-features.yt-ui-desc: Nascondi Shorts, regola la barra di navigazione e rimuovi elementi di layout indesiderati.
app-features.player-desc: Velocità di riproduzione personalizzate, qualità video predefinita e comportamento migliorato della barra di avanzamento.
app-features.swipe-desc: Regola luminosità e volume con gesti touch intuitivi.
app-features.yt-themes-desc: Nero puro, Material You e stili di tema aggiuntivi.
app-features.yt-privacy-desc: Pulisce i link di condivisione rimuovendo i parametri di tracciamento.
app-features.ytmusic-desc: Un'esperienza YouTube Music migliorata con blocco degli annunci, temi personalizzabili, miglioramenti audio e un'interfaccia più pulita
app-features.ytm-ad-desc: Rimuove tutti gli annunci durante la riproduzione musicale.
app-features.audio-desc: Disabilita la compressione della gamma dinamica e preferisce le tracce audio originali.
app-features.ytm-themes-desc: Sfondi scuri e chiari personalizzati inclusi gli stili Material You.
app-features.ytm-ui-desc: Nasconde pulsanti inutili e componenti UI per un'esperienza più pulita.
app-features.repeat-desc: Comportamento di ripetizione migliorato che persiste tra le sessioni.
app-features.ytm-link-desc: Rimuove i parametri di tracciamento dai link condivisi.
app-features.branding-desc: Personalizzazione opzionale del nome e dell'icona dell'app.
app-features.nav-bar-desc: Nascondi o personalizza la barra di navigazione inferiore e le sue etichette per ridurre il disordine.
app-features.reddit-desc: Un'esperienza Reddit ottimizzata con blocco degli annunci, personalizzazione dell'interfaccia, gestione dei link diretti e privacy migliorata
app-features.reddit-ad-desc: Rimuove gli annunci nel feed per un'esperienza di navigazione più pulita.
app-features.reddit-ui-desc: Nasconde pulsanti di navigazione, elementi della barra laterale e scaffali consigliati.
app-features.dismiss-desc: Rimuove automaticamente i popup ripetitivi di avviso della community.
app-features.direct-links-desc: Apre i link senza tracciamento dei reindirizzamenti, andando direttamente alla destinazione.
app-features.reddit-link-desc: Rimuove i parametri di tracciamento dagli URL condivisi per una migliore privacy.
app-features.clean-nav-desc: Layout semplificato con meno distrazioni per una navigazione concentrata.
app-features.screenshot-desc: Disabilita il popup che appare quando si fanno screenshot all'interno dell'app.
app-features.spoof-signature-desc: Falsifica la firma dell'app per ripristinare le notifiche push che potrebbero essere danneggiate dopo il patching.

faq-content.faq-1-answer: Morphe is a patcher for Android apps. It can patch apps and add extra features and customization.
faq-content.faq-2-answer: You can patch any app you want, as long as you want YouTube, YT Music, or Reddit. We're constantly working on expanding support to more apps.
faq-content.faq-3-answer: Download Morphe and follow the prompts to patch your app. Alternatively, you can follow the Morphe Desktop documentation to use Morphe Desktop to patch using a computer.
faq-content.faq-4-answer: As safe as modifying obfuscated bytecode can be. All source code for Morphe is open-source and free for anyone to inspect. Our community actively reviews and contributes to the codebase.
faq-content.faq-5-answer: Only if your phone decides to brick itself. Otherwise your device will be fine. Morphe only modifies app packages and doesn't touch system files.
faq-content.faq-6-answer: Yes, but don't blame Morphe if your app becomes too customized for you to handle. It's recommended to customize up to your preference level and no more.
faq-content.faq-7-answer: Morphe is a patcher for Android apps. Android is very different from iOS so it is not available on iOS. If your TV runs Android, it may be possible to use Morphe.
faq-content.faq-8-answer:
Morphe tries to support the very latest versions of YouTube and Reddit. If you like exploring and are willing to accept that some unidentified bugs may exist, then you can try patching the latest releases with Morphe. If you do not like to experiment with software or repatch often, then always patch the version recommended by Morphe.

Be aware that even if there are no unidentified bugs or issues with patching the latest, it may be full of a/b tests that show up for some users as strange UI layouts and unreleased work-in-progress features.

If Morphe Manager fails to patch the latest version of YouTube or Reddit, or you find patch bugs present in the latest that are not present in the recommended version, then please open an issue in the GitHub patches repo (Be sure to search for duplicate issues before creating a new issue).
faq-content.faq-9-answer:
What you found is a "pre-patched" APK patched by someone else.

Since there's no way to know if the APK was maliciously altered by someone else,
for the safety of your device and your online accounts you should not use pre-patched APKs.

The official and only safe way to use Morphe is to patch yourself on your phone using the Android Morphe app or on your computer using Morphe Desktop.
faq-content.faq-10-answer:
On a rooted device Morphe Manager asks how the app should be patched before patching starts, in a Choose patch mode dialog. Pick Root mount mode.

Note that in this mode you need to install the original APK after downloading it, because the patched APK is mounted over the stock app.

The matching installer entry is Settings > System > Installer > Root mount, and it only applies to apps that were patched in root mount mode. See Root mount for the details, including why branding cannot be changed for mounted installs.
faq-content.faq-11-answer: If microG is required for your patched app, you will be directed to the correct microG download page upon opening the app.
faq-content.faq-12-answer:
Morphe uses a text configuration for personalized settings which can be copied and pasted.

Go to: Settings > Morphe > Miscellaneous > Import / Export

Press the copy button to copy your settings to the clipboard. Paste your settings somewhere safe to save them (Notes app, email message, etc).

To restore your settings, paste your settings into the same Import / Export textbox and press Import.

This covers the settings inside the patched app. Morphe Manager's own settings, patch selections, and signing keystore are backed up separately, see Backing up Morphe and your keystore.
faq-content.faq-13-answer:
Using Morphe log collector website

  1. If using YouTube or YT Music, turn on Miscellaneous > Debugging > Debug logging. Do not turn on stack trace or protocol logging unless you are instructed to. If YouTube fails to launch then skip this step.
  2. Enable developer mode on your phone: https://developer.android.com/studio/debug/dev-options
  3. Verify "USB debugging" is enabled in your device Settings > Developer menu
  4. Connect your phone to a computer with a usb cable
  5. Visit https://debug.morphe.software on your computer
  6. Press "Connect device" button on the log website
  7. Approve the developer prompt on your phone
  8. Press "save" button on the website

If logs do not show on the website, unplug your phone and retry again from step 4 thru 8

Using a computer, usb cable, and terminal console

  1. Turn on Miscellaneous > Debugging > Debug logging in the settings.
  2. Install the Android developer tools on a computer, open a command prompt, and capture the logs using the command adb logcat | grep 'morphe\|AndroidRuntime to log both Morphe and crash logs. To save the logs to a file use adb logcat | grep 'morphe\|AndroidRuntime' > logs.txt
  3. Alternatively, you can use any Android app capable of capturing logs (to use these apps a one time setup is required using a computer and ADB).
  4. Alternatively, in YouTube you can copy the most recent logs directly from the Debug settings menu (No ADB or computer setup is required). But due to clipboard limitations the log is limited to the most recent log data. Crash logs can only be collected using a computer and ADB.

For problems with patching itself rather than with a patched app, export the logs from Settings > System > Debug in Morphe Manager, or copy the patcher log straight off the patching screen in Expert mode. See How patching works and how to tune it.
faq-content.faq-14-answer:
Since we are an open-source community and depend on outside help, you can always check out our GitHub repositories and contribute to Morphe by creating an issue or pull request.
You can also help with translations on Crowdin.

Additionally, financial donations are always welcome.
faq-content.faq-15-answer: Because "Android App Modification And Transformation Tool" (AAMATT) is not very catchy. And because Morphe implies it morphs your apps into something better.
faq-content.faq-16-answer: Morphe is not affiliated with ReVanced. Morphe was created by a team of former ReVanced developers and contributors.
faq-content.faq-17-answer: The website uses Umami and Google Analytics 4: No cookies, no advertising, no profiling, and no data is sold or shared. Morphe does not add analytics or data collection to any patched apps.
faq-content.troubleshooting-1-answer:
Ensure Settings > Morphe > About says "You are using the latest patches"

Then change to TV in : Settings > Morphe > Miscellaneous > Spoof video streams > Default client
faq-content.troubleshooting-2-answer:
Ensure Settings > Morphe > Video > Force original audio language is enabled.

You may also need to change to a spoof client that supports multiple audio tracks (see item 4 above).

If the audio is still auto-dubbed and "Stats for nerds" always shows Android Studio, then the original audio cannot be forced and currently there is no solution.
faq-content.troubleshooting-3-answer: Change the spoof client to either visionOS or TV Simply, see item 4 above.
faq-content.troubleshooting-4-answer: A YouTube account is required to play most children's videos. Ensure you are logged into a YouTube account and incognito mode is not enabled.
faq-content.troubleshooting-5-answer: This issue can happen after making changes to your Google account. Uninstall and reinstall microG.
faq-content.troubleshooting-6-answer:
Verify you did not enable the stock YouTube accessibility feature:
Settings > Accessibility > Accessibility player > Off
faq-content.troubleshooting-7-answer: If you use a system ad-blocker, then whitelist s.youtube.com. Otherwise verify watch history works with unpatched YouTube, and check your YouTube/Google account permissions and ensure your account watch history is enabled.
faq-content.troubleshooting-8-answer: Disable Settings > Morphe > General > Navigation buttons > Hide Shorts button.
faq-content.troubleshooting-9-answer:
Enable: Settings > Morphe > General > Spoof app version

and optionally pick a spoof version:
Settings > Morphe > General > Spoof app target

If you still don't have the old UI, then you can try patching an older version of YouTube.

Morphe supports patching some older versions of YouTube. At the present time the oldest versions that can be patched are:

  • YouTube: 20.21.37
  • YT Music: 9.15.51
  • Reddit: 2026.04.0

But always ensure you have the latest patches, even when patching older app versions.
faq-content.troubleshooting-10-answer:
Use a username/password to log in. Some devices may require temporarily turning off 2 factor authentication. Certain managed accounts such as Google Workspace, or family managed accounts may not work.

Some devices may require temporarily enabling the "Appear on top" MicroG overlay permission for login to work.

Some devices may require using the "Huawei login" button, even if not using a Huawei device.
faq-content.troubleshooting-11-answer:
This implies that you must remove the previous installation to solve the conflict.

This error can be caused by 'hidden' apps (Samsung Secure Folder, Android Work Profile, Xiaomi Hidden Apps, etc). If the same app is already installed but set hidden, then it needs to be unhidden and uninstalled before the patched app can be installed.

Patching in root mount mode avoids the conflict entirely, because the patched APK is mounted over the stock app instead of installed, see Root mount.
faq-content.troubleshooting-12-answer: If you recently uninstalled/reinstalled MicroG, and did not also uninstall/reinstall patched YouTube, then you may need to clear the YouTube app data for push notifications to work again.
faq-content.troubleshooting-14-answer:
1. Go to the Android Auto settings on your device.
  2. Scroll down to Version and permission info.
  3. Tap on it 10 times to enter developer mode.
  4. Tap the 3 dots in the upper-right corner of your screen and open the Developer settings.
  5. Scroll down and enable Unknown sources.

You may need to update/change to Morphe MicroG if you are using an old MicroG release.

Be aware that most YT Music Android Auto features require a YouTube Premium subscription.
faq-content.troubleshooting-15-answer: This likely means that the SponsorBlock servers are having issues. You can check the server status here and try again later.
faq-content.troubleshooting-16-answer:
First ensure you are using the latest patches. You may be using outdated patches even if the app version has not changed.

To update a patched app, you need to patch and install the app again. You do not need to uninstall your existing patched app to upgrade the patched app.

Patch versions are completely different from the app version, and newer patches can exist even if the app version is the same as your currently patched app. Morphe Manager puts an Update badge on the app card when the patches it was built with are outdated. Check the Settings > Morphe > About screen inside the patched app to see the same thing from there.

See Updating a patched app for the full walkthrough.

Search for existing issues here as all known issues will have an existing issue.

If videos on YouTube are pausing instantly when you press the play button, then you must disable Picture-in-picture due to an issue with your OS/YouTube.
